_about: Sessellift D4 detachable quad (v0.3.2, owner DQ1-DQ9): the D6 (sessellift_d6.json) at a 4.8 m line gauge, built by the D6's builders from the station family's quad layouts. The quad's station is the six-pack's with one 3,200 mm portal bay taken out of its line-end straight; the D6's heights are kept (DQ9). The chair is the Sessellift quad chair on the D6's hanger at the D6's drop, on the detachable grip (DQ3); the rope is the quad kit's 1 3/4 in (DQ4). Millimetres.
_kit: the integrated tower's hold-down rows are the quad kit's line assembly (tower.assembly, DQ2)

common.loadedRope: right when looking uphill: v+ at the bottom terminal, v- at the top terminal
common.tensioning: top (the top terminal carries the tension carriage)

chair._about: The Sessellift quad chair (sessellift_fgq4.json chair) by the D6 chair's rules at widen 0 (assets/d6_chair.py derive): its own body (body quad) hung at the D6's drop on the D6's hanger, clamp and top bar, so it loads at the D6's height (DQ9).

stations._about: Each end from a D6 end section with one 3,200 mm bay taken out of the line-end straight and moved shift mm along the line (liftkit/gauge.py quad_station; Gate 0: hood, front mast, bend sheaves, belly and rear mast within 20 mm of the layouts). The bottom is drawn as the drive, the top as the return with the tension carriage (DQ6). load: the end riders board at.

bottom._about: Measured on the bottom's layout: the chair rail's back turn (tighter than the D6 drive's, which cannot narrow 400 mm; its centre at v 657, measured 645, so the turn meets the straight at the gauge rule's rail v 2,534), the rail's back for the riders; the front mast as the D6 return's (top of concrete, head and the ladder on the line side).

integratedTower._about: The bottom's integrated tower (DQ5), measured on the bottom's layout (w: the D6's heights, the sheet's +100, DQ9): on each rope the quad kit's hold-down row of eight (liftkit/heads.py hung_assembly) pinned under a crossbeam over both ropes; a mast from the crossbeam's middle; a railed deck from the hood's nose under the ropes' inside; a railed walkway inboard of each row out to its far end, hung from the crossbeam; two arms from a yoke on the hood's roof out past its nose, on posts down to the deck. The row is drawn nearly level: the kit's flat arc (40 m).
integratedTower._outerYoke: owner option A (Gate 1): the kit rows' inboard yokes only, so the detachable grip's tyre plate passes outboard (the kit's outboard yokes stand in it)
